0022600170.text: The Suns (1-3, 0-2 on the road, on a two-game losing streak) sit 3rd in the Pacific, 2.5 games back and 12th in the West, as they visit the Warriors (4-3, on a four-game winning streak) in Golden State's seventh game of the season and Phoenix's fifth. Mark Williams is out for Phoenix with a shoulder injury following surgery, while Golden State is missing Al Horford (rest), Gui Santos (knee), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Brandon Williams is day-to-day with a quadriceps bruise and a game-time decision. The Suns lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 131-122 win in Phoenix on October 24, though they lost the 2025-26 series 1-3.
